steps: Peel and dice Sweet potato into 1 cm cubes; finely chop Onion and mince Garlic.
Cook Rice according to package directions; set aside and keep warm.
Heat Olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat until shimmering.
Add Onion and Garlic; cook for 3 minutes, stirring, until softened.
Stir in Ground cumin and Turmeric; cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add Sweet potato, Crushed tomatoes, and Unsalted vegetable broth; stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes, until sweet potato is fork-tender.
Stir in Cooked lentils and Spinach; cook for 2 minutes until spinach wilts.
Serve the lentil mixture over Rice. Keeps refrigerated up to 3 days; freeze portions up to 1 month.
